review.en: Drake's third and last album was recorded in two late-night sessions with only voice and guitar, plus a single piano overdub, and runs under half an hour. It sold very little, and he died in 1974. Later decades rediscovered it, and its plainness became a touchstone for quiet, inward songwriting.
review.zh: 德雷克的第三张、也是最后一张专辑，在两个深夜录完，只有人声和吉他，外加一段钢琴叠录，全长不到半小时。它当时几乎没有销量，他在 1974 年去世。后来的年代重新发现了它，这份朴素成了安静内省式写作的试金石。
